name: Paths to *
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..6]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) CONTAINS '*' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to the * resource

name: Paths to IAM
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..6]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) = 'iam' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to the IAM resource

name: Paths to Principal
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..6]->(z)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND (z:AWSUser OR z:AWSRole OR z:AWSGroup OR z:AWSPrincipal) AND n<>z AND z.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:IAM::CHANGEME:ROLE/CHANGE' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to a principal

name: Paths from Principal
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..6]->(res:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND n.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:IAM::CHANGEME:USER/CHANGE' OPTIONAL MATCH rp = (res)-[*1..2]->(r) RETURN p, rp LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths from a principal

name: All Administrators
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..4]->(z)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND ((z:AWSPolicy AND (toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'administratoraccess' OR toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'poweruseraccess')) OR (z:AWSResource AND z.name = '*')) RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all administrators

name: Roles Attached to Services
query: MATCH p = (:AWSResource)-[:awsAgentCoreBrowserRole|:awsAgentCoreCodeInterpreterRole|:awsAgentCoreGatewayRole|:awsAgentCoreRuntimeRole|:awsCloudFormationStackRole|:awsCodeBuildProjectRole|:awsCodePipelineRole|:awsCognitoAuthenticatedRole|:awsCognitoMappedRole|:awsCognitoUnauthenticatedRole|:awsEc2InstanceRole|:awsEcsTaskExecutionRole|:awsEcsTaskRole|:awsEksClusterRole|:awsEksNodeRole|:awsLambdaInstanceRole|:awsRdsClusterRole|:awsRdsInstanceRole|:awsRdsMonitoringRole|:awsSageMakerDomainRole|:awsSageMakerModelRole|:awsSageMakerNotebookRole|:awsSageMakerPipelineRole|:awsSageMakerUserProfileRole|:awsStateMachineRole]->(r:AWSRole) OPTIONAL MATCH q = (r)-[:awsAttachedPolicy]->(:AWSPolicy) RETURN p, q LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all roles attached to a service

name: Paths to Inline Policies
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..3]->(z:AWSPolicy)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND z.objectid CONTAINS ':INLINE/' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to inline policies

name: All Foreign Principals
query: MATCH p = (r:AWSPrincipal)-[:awsAssumeRoleAllowed]->(z:AWSRole)-[*1..3]->(res:AWSResource) WHERE toLower(r.type) <> 'service' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all foreign principals

name: Paths to SecretsManager
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..6]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) = 'secretsmanager' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to SecretsManager

name: Paths to Resource with Edge Restriction
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..6]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) = 'lambda' WITH p WHERE any(r IN relationships(p) WHERE type(r) = 'lambdaAllAccess') RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to a resource with specific edges

name: Policies with Modify Permissions
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSPolicy)-[r]->(z:AWSResource) WHERE type(r) CONTAINS 'Create' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'Put' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'Update' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'Add' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'Attach' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'Delete' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'Modify' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'Set' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'Replace' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'Write' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'PassRole' OR type(r) CONTAINS 'AllAccess' OPTIONAL MATCH rp = allShortestPaths((v)-[*1..3]->(n)) WHERE (v:AWSUser OR v:AWSRole OR v:AWSGroup OR v:AWSPrincipal) RETURN p,rp LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths with edges that allow you to modify resources

name: Resource Relationships Excluding AWS
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..6]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND NOT toLower(n.objectid) CONTAINS ':role/aws-service-role/' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths from principals to resources, excluding AWS service linked roles

name: All Users
query: MATCH (r:AWSUser) OPTIONAL MATCH p = (r)-[*1..2]->(z:AWSPolicy) RETURN r, p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all users

name: All Policies Attached to Role
query: MATCH p = (r:AWSRole)-[:awsAttachedPolicy]->(z:AWSPolicy) WHERE r.objectid='ARN:AWS:IAM::CHANGEME:ROLE/CHANGE' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all policies attached to a role

name: Access to S3 Bucket
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..6]->(z)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND (z:AWSResource) AND z.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:S3:::CHANGE' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to an S3 bucket

name: Identities Tied to Cognito
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSResource)-[:awsCognitoAuthenticatedRole|:awsCognitoUnauthenticatedRole]->(r)-[]->(:AWSPolicy) RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all identities tied to Cognito pools

name: All AgentCore Roles
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSResource)-[:awsAgentCoreRuntimeRole|:awsAgentCoreGatewayRole|:awsAgentCoreCodeInterpreterRole|:awsAgentCoreBrowserRole]->(r:AWSRole) WHERE toLower(n.name) = 'bedrock-agentcore' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all identities tied to AgentCore

name: Paths to AgentCore Roles
query: MATCH (h:AWSResource)-[:awsAgentCoreRuntimeRole|:awsAgentCoreGatewayRole|:awsAgentCoreCodeInterpreterRole|:awsAgentCoreBrowserRole]->(t:AWSRole) WHERE toLower(h.name) = 'bedrock-agentcore' MATCH p = allShortestPaths((s)-[*1..]->(t)) WHERE (s:AWSUser OR s:AWSRole OR s:AWSGroup OR s:AWSPrincipal) AND s <> t RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to AgentCore

name: All SageMaker Roles
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSResource)-[:awsSageMakerNotebookRole|:awsSageMakerDomainRole|:awsSageMakerUserProfileRole|:awsSageMakerModelRole|:awsSageMakerPipelineRole]->(r:AWSRole) WHERE toLower(n.name) = 'sagemaker' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all SageMaker roles

name: SageMaker Notebooks with Administrative Roles
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSResource)-[:awsSageMakerNotebookRole]->(r:AWSRole)-[:awsAttachedPolicy]->(z:AWSPolicy) WHERE toLower(n.name) = 'sagemaker' AND (toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'administratoraccess' OR toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'poweruseraccess') RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify notebooks with administrative roles

name: Access to IaC Buckets
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*1..6]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND z.iacTool IS NOT NULL RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to IaC buckets

name: Wildcard Trust Conditions
query: MATCH p = (n)-[q:awsAssumeRoleAllowed]->(z:AWSRole) WHERE (n:AWSPrincipal OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSUser) AND q.condition CONTAINS '*' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all trust relationships with a wildcard in their condition, including in-account role to role
